nl: 保险理赔管理：查询有保单号、理赔类型（车险/医疗险/财产险）；表格展示保单号、理赔类型、出险日期、定损员；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「定损员」只在理赔类型为「车险」时才需要指定，其余类型隐藏。
nlEn: Insurance claim management: query by policy number and claim type (auto / medical / property); the table shows policy number, claim type, incident date, and loss assessor; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "loss assessor" only needs to be assigned when the claim type is "auto"; it is hidden for the other types.
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=nIn — 非车险时隐藏定损员（vue3/sfc，条件随 formItems 一起内联进 SFC）
